interpretation: A Bernoulli same-price refill after each touch fill models the iceberg reserve: hidden fills make up p·(fills on refilled levels) of volume. p=0.25 targets the tape's 21.4% fill share. The reload chain is geometric — true icebergs have finite reserves and a visible peak — so the model is a first-order approximation; the residual divergence (sim hidden fills are unit-sized while real hidden fills average 90 shares) is logged honestly.
